title: About
author: djordje.thai
excerpt: The experience behind Business Online Mastery.
contentHtml:
My name is Dorde Medakovic. For more than 30 years I have worked as an owner and manager in the information-technology and IT-services industry.

Business Online Mastery is where I share what that experience continues to teach me—from AI and large language models to data, Power BI, digital business, learning, and SEO.

The goal is practical: make complex technology easier to understand, connect it to real business work, and share lessons that may help other professionals and entrepreneurs.
seoDescription: Learn about the professional experience and purpose behind Business Online Mastery.
